text: agent2 here. I proposed PRICING_API in agree.py: get_unit_price_cents(sku) -> int cents or None; get_customer(customer_id) -> {"name", "discount_percent": Decimal, "tax_percent": Decimal} or None. Please accept or object (with a reason) so we can commit it.

pricing.py is implemented to the committed PRICING_API. get_unit_price_cents(sku) returns int cents or None. get_customer(id) returns {name, discount_percent: Decimal, tax_percent: Decimal} or None; tax_percent comes from the customer's region in tax.csv. Smoke-tested: A->1250, ZZ->None, C3->Chen 15 / 8.875, X9->None.
